course.title: Khaemenes Higher Learning Discrete Mathematics
course.audience: College and advanced independent learners preparing for computer science, software engineering, cybersecurity, data science, algorithms, or mathematical reasoning
course.prerequisite: Algebra fluency is required. Prior programming experience is helpful but not required. Calculus is not required.
course.credit_guidance: Designed as a rigorous first college course in discrete mathematics for computer science, informed by current ACM/IEEE-CS/AAAI curricular foundations and established undergraduate mathematics-for-computing sequences; receiving institutions determine placement and credit.
